Let $x_i = a_i - 1$. Since $a_i$ are distinct positive integers greater than 1, the $x_i$ are distinct positive integers. The condition becomes:
$$\prod_{i=1}^m \frac{x_i}{x_i+1} = \frac{7}{335} \iff \prod_{i=1}^m \frac{x_i+1}{x_i} = \frac{335}{7}$$
